title: Taj Mahal, Agra
headline: A Timeless Symbol of Love
description: One of the world's most iconic monuments, the Taj Mahal is celebrated for its magnificent white marble architecture, intricate craftsmanship, and romantic history.
altText: Majestic marble architecture of Taj Mahal at sunrise reflecting in tranquil pool

title: Hawa Mahal, Jaipur
headline: The Palace of Winds
description: Rising like a honeycomb of rose-pink sandstone, Hawa Mahal's 953 intricately latticed windows once let royal ladies observe street festivals unseen — a masterpiece of Rajput grandeur.
altText: Intricate pink sandstone facade of Hawa Mahal in the royal city of Jaipur

title: Kerala Backwaters
headline: Drift Through God's Own Country
description: A shimmering network of lagoons, canals, and lakes lined with swaying coconut palms — Kerala's backwaters offer a uniquely serene escape aboard traditional rice-boat houseboats.
altText: Traditional luxury houseboat cruising serene emerald waterways of Kerala backwaters

title: Goa Beaches
headline: Sun, Sand & Soul
description: From the bustling shores of Baga to the tranquil coves of Palolem, Goa's golden beaches blend Portuguese heritage, vibrant nightlife, and breathtaking Arabian Sea sunsets.
altText: Golden sands, coastal palms, and azure waves of tropical Goa beach during sunset

title: Pangong Lake, Ladakh
headline: Where the Sky Meets the Earth
description: Stretching 134 km across the Himalayas into Tibet, Pangong Lake's impossibly vivid blue waters shift through a dozen shades at altitude — a high-altitude wonder like no other.
altText: Shimmering high-altitude turquoise waters of Pangong Lake nestled beneath jagged mountains

title: Mussoorie
headline: Queen of the Hills
description: Perched at 2,000 metres above sea level, Mussoorie enchants with its colonial-era charm, misty Himalayan panoramas, cascading Kempty Falls, and cool mountain breeze year-round.
altText: Misty pine-covered slopes and mountain ridges of Mussoorie queen of the hills

title: Nainital
headline: The Lake District of India
description: Cradled by seven emerald hills and anchored by the glimmering Naini Lake, Nainital is Uttarakhand's most beloved hill resort — perfect for boating, hiking, and crisp mountain air.
altText: Picturesque emerald Naini Lake surrounded by forested hill peaks and colonial cottages

title: Auli
headline: India's Premier Ski Destination
description: Blanketed in fresh powder with jaw-dropping views of Nanda Devi, Auli's pristine slopes draw skiers and trekkers alike — and host Asia's highest golf course come summer.
altText: Snow-dusted alpine meadows and Himalayan ski slopes of Auli facing Nanda Devi

title: Rishikesh
headline: The Yoga Capital of the World
description: Where the Ganges rushes down from the Himalayas, Rishikesh beckons with sacred ghats, thrilling white-water rafting, ancient ashrams, and a spiritual energy that transforms every visitor.
altText: Spiritual twilight Aarti on the sacred banks of the Ganges river in Rishikesh

title: Valley of Flowers
headline: A Living Carpet of Himalayan Blooms
description: UNESCO-listed and breathtakingly remote, the Valley of Flowers bursts into a riot of 500 species of wildflowers each monsoon season — a sight that feels entirely otherworldly.
altText: Vibrant alpine wildflower blossoms carpeting high altitude Himalayan glacial valley
